env.locale: en_US, ar for the 390 RTL check (restored)

c-member-share.1.evidence: bob on a topic: Share opens a 187px dropdown directly under the button (menu x191-378, y488; button bottom y484) with Copy link, Twitter / X, Facebook, LinkedIn.

c-member-share.2.evidence: Copy link wrote the exact topic URL to the clipboard (readText equals the page URL) and showed the toast 'Link copied'.

c-member-share.3.evidence: Each item opens a new tab: X intent/tweet with url and text=<title>, Facebook sharer.php?u=<url>, LinkedIn shareArticle?url=<url> (X and LinkedIn bounce through their login redirects, the target URL is preserved).

c-member-share.4.evidence: With the dropdown open, a wheel scroll closes it (aria-expanded false); a click outside closes it.

c-member-share.5.evidence: Escape closes the dropdown, aria-expanded returns to false and focus returns to the Share button; Enter and Space open it, ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Home/End move between the four items.

c-member-share.6.evidence: Guest on a public topic: the Share button opens its dropdown (aria-expanded true, 187x150px, anchored). Nit: a click in the first ~1.2s after load is ignored until the interactive store hydrates (works from ~1.6s).

c-member-share.7.evidence: alice (member) on a Partner Program topic: Share offers the same four items with the same private URL; the oEmbed endpoint returns 404 for that topic, so nothing from the body is exposed through sharing.

c-member-share.8.evidence: Guest GET /oembed?url=<public topic> -> 200 with title and author_name (Grace...); partner-program topic and a moderators-room URL -> 404 jetonomy_oembed_not_found.

c-member-share.9.evidence: Grace's 159-char title: the X link carries the title in text=, the heading wraps (159px tall) at 390, the dropdown stays inside the viewport.

c-member-share.10.evidence: 390px with site language ar (RTL, restored): dropdown x40-227 of 390, opening toward the inline end and fully inside the viewport.

c-member-share.11.evidence: With navigator.clipboard.writeText rejecting and execCommand('copy') false, Copy link shows 'Could not copy the link. Copy it from the address bar.'
